::: {#rem-algorithm-model}
#### What counts as an algorithm and a step

@arora2009computational [chapter 1] make "algorithm" precise as a
[Turing machine](models-of-computation.qmd#def-turing-machine),
and count one step as one move of the machine.
Read "algorithm" either way:
as a Turing machine,
or as any program for an ordinary computer,
with one step per basic operation on a bounded number of bits.
The two models can simulate each other
with at most a polynomial increase in running time
[@arora2009computational, chapter 1],
so they agree on which problems are in P.

:::
